reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Office for Project Services

description.narrative: This project is to support the provision of equipment and services required for the destruction of 12 chemical weapons productions facilities by the Syrian Arab Republic and for OPCW (Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons) operations in the Syrian Arab Republic. This includes the destruction of seven aircraft hangars and five underground structures. Specifically UNOP assists with the contract management and engagement of companies, suppliers, personnel and contractors (as assessed and pre-selected by the OPCW) as well as the procurement of equipment, explosives and grouting material according to the needs as assessed by the contracted supplier and the OPCW-UN Joint Mission.
